smbs.config-v3.spawning.desc: Global settings for when and how strongly mobs are buffed.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.enabled.desc: When disabled, no new mobs will receive buffs. Mobs that are already buffed keep their buffs and rewards.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.minChanceDifficu: At and below this local difficulty, rules use their minimum spawn and buff chances.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.maxChanceDifficu: At and above this local difficulty, rules use their maximum spawn and buff chances. The highest possible local difficulty is 6.75.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.minLevelDifficul: At and below this local difficulty, buffs are always applied at level 1.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.maxLevelDifficul: At and above this local difficulty, buffs can reach their maximum level.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.levelExponent.de: Buff levels are rolled as difficulty × random × (max level - 1) ^ exponent, limited to the max level. Higher values make high levels more common.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.maxBuffsPerMob.d: If a mob rolls more buffs than this, a random selection of them is applied. 0 means unlimited.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.allowedSpawnSour: Only mobs spawned in one of these ways can receive buffs.
smbs.config-v3.spawning.dimensionFilterM: Whether the dimension list below is a blacklist or a whitelist.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.desc: Settings for the extra rewards buffed mobs drop when killed by a player.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.xpPerBuffLevel.de: The mob drops one XP orb worth this much XP for each buff level.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.bookThresholdPerc: The mob needs a buff level higher than this percentage of its highest possible buff level to drop an enchanted book.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.bookEnchantmentTa: Enchantment tag the book's enchantment is picked from.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.bookBonusLevels.d: The book's highest possible enchantment level is the amount the buff level exceeds the threshold by, plus this value.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.increasedEquipmen: When enabled, weapons and armor worn by mobs have a higher chance to drop the stronger the mob is.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.maxEquipmentDropM: The equipment drop chance multiplier goes from 1 up to this value as the mob's buff level approaches its highest possible buff level.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.leaderBuffLevelBo: Extra buff levels for zombie-type mobs that spawn as leaders.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.enchantedEquipmen: Extra buff levels for each enchanted piece of equipment the mob wears.
smbs.config-v3.rewards.equipmentCountsTo: When disabled, the enchanted equipment bonus also raises the mob's highest possible buff level, so it barely affects the enchanted book threshold.
smbs.config-v3.weapons.desc: Weapon lists used by rules. Item IDs and item tags (starting with #) are accepted.
smbs.config-v3.weapons.meleeWeapons.desc: Weapons checked by rules with the Melee weapons requirement.
smbs.config-v3.weapons.rangedWeapons.des: Weapons checked by rules with the Ranged weapons requirement, and used to pick a rule's ranged buff set.
smbs.config-v3.buffSets.desc: Named groups of buffs that rules can use. Each buff has a maximum level.
smbs.config-v3.rules.desc: Each rule assigns a buff set to a group of mobs. A mob matching several rules rolls each rule separately, and keeps the highest level of any buff it rolls more than once.
smbs.config-v3.statBoosts.desc: Settings for the mod's own buffs.
smbs.config-v3.misc.disableVanillaSpider: Stops spiders from receiving random effects on Hard difficulty in vanilla, since the buff system replaces them.
smbs.config-v3.misc.healZombieLeaders.de: Fixes zombie leaders spawning without the extra health their leader bonus gives them.
smbs.config-v3.misc.cloudEffectDurationC: Buffs last forever, so effect clouds left by exploding creepers would pass them on permanently. Infinite effects from clouds are limited to this duration. -1 keeps them infinite.
smbs.config-v3.misc.debugLogging.desc: Logs buffed mob spawns and reward drops.
smbs.buffSet.name: Name
smbs.buffSet.name.desc: Rules refer to this buff set by this name.
smbs.buffSet.buffs.desc: Status effects or stat boosts, each with the maximum level it can be applied at.
smbs.buffRule.name: Name
smbs.buffRule.name.desc: Optional. Shown in the rule list instead of the mob names.
smbs.buffRule.mobs.desc: Entity IDs or entity tags (starting with #) this rule applies to.
smbs.buffRule.requiredWeapon.desc: The weapon the mob must spawn with for this rule to apply.
smbs.buffRule.customWeapons.desc: Used if Required weapon is set to Custom.
smbs.buffRule.buffSet.desc: Name of the buff set this rule applies.
smbs.buffRule.rangedBuffSet.desc: Optional. Used instead of the buff set when the mob holds a ranged weapon.
smbs.buffRule.minSpawnChance.desc: Chance for matching mobs to roll this rule's buffs at the chance scaling start difficulty and below.
smbs.buffRule.maxSpawnChance.desc: Chance for matching mobs to roll this rule's buffs at the chance scaling end difficulty and above.
smbs.buffRule.minBuffChance.desc: Chance for each buff in the set to be applied at the chance scaling start difficulty and below.
smbs.buffRule.maxBuffChance.desc: Chance for each buff in the set to be applied at the chance scaling end difficulty and above.
smbs.weaponType.ANY.desc: The rule applies regardless of the mob's weapon.
smbs.weaponType.MELEE.desc: The mob must hold a weapon from the Melee weapons list.
smbs.weaponType.RANGED.desc: The mob must hold a weapon from the Ranged weapons list.
smbs.weaponType.CUSTOM.desc: The mob must hold a weapon from the rule's Custom weapons list.
smbs.spawnSource.NATURAL.desc: Natural spawns, world generation, patrols, events and jockeys.
smbs.spawnSource.CONVERSION.desc: Mobs created by converting another mob, such as a witch struck by lightning.
smbs.spawnSource.SPAWN_EGG.desc: Spawn eggs, including ones used by dispensers.
smbs.filterMode.BLACKLIST.desc: Mobs are not buffed in the listed dimensions.
smbs.filterMode.WHITELIST.desc: Mobs are only buffed in the listed dimensions.
